SMTO-EXE-0043 — SMTO didn't get any result back from an action

GUID: 4d0ab355-0ab1-4f89-bf30-c3d454d8fc14
Slug: adapter-result-missing
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: exe

What happened

  • SMTO started an action but got nothing back, not even an error. It can't tell whether the action happened or what it changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check the thing the action was working on, such as the file, message or service. Or ask SMTO in the conversation to look at it without changing anything. The action may have worked even though SMTO received no report about it.
  2. Only if it didn't happen, ask SMTO to do the action again. Repeating an action that already worked could make the same change twice.
  3. Open Technical details in this panel and select Copy error details. An action that returns nothing at all is a fault in SMTO that someone should look into.

What success looks like

  • You have confirmed whether the action happened, and any repeat finishes with a normal result.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened before trying it again. Send the copied error details, with the conversation name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep repeating the action until you know what the first attempt did.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The concrete execution path for a tool call returned no ExecutionResult, so no receipt establishes whether the operation ran or what it changed.

What this means

  • The concrete execution path reached result construction without a returned execution result, leaving no adapter receipt to establish success or effects. Execution, resource reconciliation and retries remain owned by the existing control flow. Use retained per-operation facts to distinguish this request from earlier effects; this explanation performs no additional work.

Why this can happen

  • The concrete execution path reached result construction without a returned execution result, leaving no adapter receipt to establish success or effects.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect original operation records and target state, and retain the missing-result defect for the adapter owner.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the target system and existing execution records (Gateway job, run receipts) for this operation_id to establish whether it took effect (agent_runtime.native.operations.execute_operation, error 'execution returned no result'). Report the missing result as a defect in that capability's execution path; do not assume nothing happened or replay the operation before its effects are known.
  • Inspect the target state and existing execution records. Report the adapter defect; do not assume that no operation happened.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The original operation is reconciled and the adapter returns a valid receipt for future authorized work.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Execution, resource reconciliation and retries remain owned by the existing control flow. Use retained per-operation facts to distinguish this request from earlier effects; this explanation performs no additional work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
